title: Integral completed strict-tower interfaces at independent universes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and its fixed uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and any scheme morphism $g:X\to Y$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. The scheme universe $t$ and field universe $u$ are independent. On the original small pro-etale site of each $W$, let $S_{W,n}=(A/\varpi^{n+1})_W$, $R_W=\varprojlim_n S_{W,n}$ and $\pi_{W,n}:R_W\to S_{W,n}$ be the specified sheaves and projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Put $\mathcal M_W=\operatorname{Mod}(R_W)$, with coefficient universe $\max(u,t+1)$, and $\operatorname{Tow}_W=(\mathbf N^{op}\to\mathcal M_W)$. Use the unbounded derived categories and their canonical localization functors $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Transpose diagrams of cochain complexes into cochain complexes of towers by the standard transposition [def-pur-principal-quotient-completion-model]. Define $F_W(P)$ to be the transpose of the actual strict reduction tower $P\otimes_{R_W}S_{W,n}$ with its quotient transitions [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. A resolving pair for a cochain functor $F:C(\mathcal M_W)\to C(\operatorname{Tow}_Z)$ is a functor $LF:D(\mathcal M_W)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}_Z)$ and a universal left-derived counit $LF\circ Q\to Q\circ F$ which is invertible on every flat-term K-flat complex [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex]. Define the reduction pair of $W$ by this universal property applied to $F_W$, retaining its counit; this is the $\mathcal O_E$ specialization of strict derived reduction [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For pullback, let $g_*$ be the actual small-site direct image on ring sheaves. Define $c_g^\sharp:R_Y\to g_*R_X$ by its finite components $\pi_{Y,n}$ followed by the canonical constant-coefficient map $S_{Y,n}\to g_*S_{X,n}$; the components commute with every quotient transition. Define $g_*^R:\mathcal M_X\to\mathcal M_Y$ by direct image with scalar action through $c_g^\sharp$, and define $G_g$ as its left adjoint with its adjunction unit (the ordinary ringed module pullback, not assumed exact). Define the additive strict tower pullback $G_g^{Tow}$ by applying $G_g$ to every object and transition. Define $V_g:D(\operatorname{Tow}_Y)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}_X)$ together with its universal left-derived counit for termwise $G_g^{Tow}$; it has a triangulated integer-shift structure and its counit is invertible on each tower complex whose every evaluation is K-flat. These universal counits specify the derived functors up to their unique counit-compatible isomorphisms. This is the strict-tower part of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], before completion or derived inverse limit. No invertibility of $c_g$, boundedness, constructibility, or invertibility of $\ell$ on $X$ or $Y$ is required for these constructions.
